_comment: Semantic token → palette step map for DARK mode, retuned to the approved MyCSC dark theme v2 spec (neutral dark-gray surfaces, no near-blacks; elevation reads from progressively lighter surfaces + hairline borders, not shadows). The surface ladder + neutral borders/text draw from the hand-tuned dark-neutral `slate` ramp (values are the spec's neutrals verbatim; `slate-850` was added for the inset/muted tier). Bright interactive teal (fills, links, focus) draws from the ACCENT family's generated steps — the pre-anchor primary steps are chroma-tapered for light-mode use and read washed on dark surfaces, while accent-500/400/300 land on the spec's #3BB8B0/#56CFC8/#8AE0DA almost exactly; deep navy-teal fills (nav chrome, subtle fills) stay on primary steps, one step lighter than before. Trade-off vs ADR-0011: re-seeding `primary` rebrands dark nav/subtle but not the bright fills — re-seed `accent` to move those. Verified with scripts/audit-contrast.mjs. Keep keys in sync with light.json. Mode-invariant roles (inverse-*) live in invariant.json.
_comment-logo: Dark logo per the MyCSC dark spec: near-white star + wordmark with the magenta kite kept as a brightened literal (fixed brand mark, like the light-mode literals — off the palette so consumer re-seeding cannot recolor it).
